content: .{@-अवतारः, -तरणम्@} [<sab>ष˚ त˚</sab>] descent (on earth) of parts of deities, partial incarnation; ˚तार इव धर्मस्य <ls>Dk. 153</ls>; ˚रमिव कृतान्तस्य <ls>K. 31</ls>;  ˚उच्चैःश्रवसः <ls n="K.">79</ls>; so अंशावतीर्णमिव <ls n="K.">108</ls>; <ab>N.</ab> of a sub-parvan covering Adhyāyas 64-67 of Ādiparvan of <ls>Mb.</ls> Even without the compound अंश means partial incarnation. अंश, आवेश, and अवतार are the three kinds of Lordʼs manifestations.
